{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rivordak Electronics Company''' was a company affiliated with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Syndicate]]. The company was used to funnel [[Spice/Legends|spice]], smuggled weapons and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. [[Tavia Kitik]] once worked there but as soon as her sister [[Bink Kitik|Bink]] learned of the company's true nature, she had Tavia quit from her job without telling her the truth about the company.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref>
